description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: single sofa along upper wall in living zone facing the lower exterior wall and seating area. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall right of entry. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, straight corridor, running the full depth of the apartment. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (open two facing units). Double bedroom in a central position within the apartment. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families needing multiple bedrooms; households needing a dedicated home office (no desk space visible); wheelchair users (long narrow corridor and tight room access); roommates wanting separate private bedrooms.
